The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
hashmap_free(link->bond_slaves);
```
```c
link_detach_from_manager(link);
```
```c
free(link);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the `link->bond_slaves` hashmap is freed without ensuring that the link is properly detached from its master link's `bond_slaves` hashmap. This can lead to an invalid memory access when the link is freed while still being referenced in the master link's hashmap, resulting in attempts to access freed memory.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (link->network) {
    if (link->network->bond &&
        link_get(link->manager, link->network->bond->ifindex, &master) >= 0)
        (void) hashmap_remove(master->bond_slaves, INT_TO_PTR(link->ifindex));
}
```
Reason:
These statements ensure that before the `link` is freed, it is properly removed from its master link's `bond_slaves` hashmap if it is part of a bond. This prevents any invalid memory access by ensuring that the link is no longer referenced in the master link's hashmap, thus avoiding potential crashes or undefined behavior.
